message.reasoning_content:
Key risk: kernel computes target_prob - draft_prob without clamping to >= 0 (max(...,0)). Negative residuals give negative scores, never argmax (unless all masked... if all scores negative, argmax picks largest which is fine since largest negative is closest to zero — but a negative score is always < 0, and some positive residual presumably exists). But if all residuals negative (all over-proposed tokens), kernel picks one with a negative score — should never return over-proposed token. Also uninitialized recovered_id=0 default if all -inf. Also masked score uses -inf, but negative-prob entries are not masked — a token with target<draft gets negative score which can win if all others are -inf/0? Score 0 could tie. Also potential issue: `recovered_id = 0` Python int vs tensor, tl.minimum ok. Also tl.max with all -inf fine.

Main bug surface: missing max(prob,0) clamp per contract. Record update.
